root_cause.evidence: The normal task loaded row 0 with mask 0x0003 and reached the first serve response drive, proving an issuable product existed. serve_normal_beat leaves service ready high and holds response valid across an extra posedge after response acceptance; legal random traffic independently produced request/response hold failures. The expected second beat can therefore be accepted or faulted outside the second serve call before that call begins.
root_cause.boundary_fault: not directly dumped; wrapper source proves a held/spurious response can set it, so any such fault is a likely secondary TB effect

minimum_source_only_repair_gate.request_ready_rule: hold each ready through its one accepted request and retire it only at a race-free edge after request-valid suppression; prove exactly one fire
minimum_source_only_repair_gate.response_rule: hold valid and payload stable until the exact ready/accept edge, then deassert on the immediately following negedge; remove the extra posedge
minimum_source_only_repair_gate.beat_boundary_rule: before the second serve, prove prior response count advanced exactly once, both response valids are zero, and wrapper request state is retired
minimum_source_only_repair_gate.normal_timeout_dump: all normal request/response watchdog failures must call the state-dump task before fatal
minimum_source_only_repair_gate.regression: retain 24 random transactions, all attacks, II=2, two-source normal row, and require zero SVA assertion failures
